evidence: Reviewed all157 criteria (145 Functional,5 Polish,5 Visual,2 gates) against quality32: most provide concrete inputs, saved state deltas, fresh product readback, or anchored visual observations. The functional prompt prohibits source inspection and guessed routes (lines3,13,17), requires distinct per-session controls and recorded before/after facts (13,19), and provides exact arithmetic/calendar, ABA, retry and concurrent witnesses. Browser MCP raw observations demonstrate newContext, ordinary request replay and real-response interruption; their40 source bindings matched the frozen solution. Those finite observations do not establish configured judging. Confirmed exception, all6 instances: hro_change_prepare_recruiter, hro_change_prepare_comp, hro_change_prepare_tier1, hro_change_prepare_tier2, hro_change_prepare_tier3 and hro_change_prepare_auditor in frozen task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:1208,1226,1244,1262,1280,1298 require ?403 with unchanged financial state?; shared prompt.md:67 repeats that bar. They do not read back the durable preview outcome owned by Prepare. Public hireops_rules.md:424-429 forbids other roles from preparing;440-442 explicitly distinguishes a durable preview from financial settlement. Actual isolated network-disabled Docker witness evidence/32/run.json (exit0,13.38705849647522seconds) used a read-only frozen task mount and two private copies. Each copy first supplied a successful Finance UI prepare with fresh Auditor UI readback. Each of the6 forbidden actors then replayed that UI-observed request with a new operation key. Unmodified source returned403, unchanged requisitions/offers/movements/grants/cancellations/payments/referrals/after-images/settlement audit and0 added previews for each actor. The save_then_forbid variant returned the same403 and identical financial state but added1 PREVIEW per actor; all6 appeared in ordinary Auditor history (results.json and save_then_forbid-auditor.png; full per-actor before/after JSON retained). Thus the stated observations cannot distinguish the required permission outcome from this broken app. The mutant moves authorization after successful preview persistence; it is not a defect claimed in the reference. Original module SHA25621e6e3080cf2815e5c37606b2680f5a643fade86b82faaa65b3994d70adb9725 remained unchanged; mutant0355e5a4d242fbf19f35ae0ff5d4db665524529392513e77faecd2677eef4b3e. Conforming-alternative check: a valid implementation may emit generic security logs for these refusals, retain existing Finance previews and choose generated IDs/route/layout/field names. The criterion already permits these variations and the fix should compare newly created or changed valid saved previews through the actual observed product interface, not demand every record/count unchanged. The indexed optional-empty-operational-history variant also completed its15 finite domain groups; this does not prove a configured grade. Full configured judge duration/grading, empirical reward discrimination/ranking, private deterministic checker execution, hosted QC, Oracle and target-model scores remain unmeasured; no grade or timing clearance is claimed.
counterexample: A prepare handler validates and durably saves a change-set PREVIEW for any signed-in actor, then returns403 to non-Finance actors after persistence. Because previews intentionally do not alter finances, all6 written wrong-role prepare bars observe403 and unchanged financial state while unauthorized valid operations remain saved. The private-copy mutation reproduced this for Recruiter, Comp partner, all3 Approvers and Auditor, following a successful Finance UI control.
suggested_fix: For each of the6 wrong-role Prepare rows and shared B5, capture saved preview identities/content before the unique-key replay and require a fresh authorized history/product read to show no new or changed valid preview from the denied attempt, while allowing generic security logs and existing legitimate previews.
